UsageAccount.title: UsageAccount
UsageAccount.description: Deterministic usage account of one entitlement: metered-event count, exact decimal total units, first/last instants, and the sorted event content digests.

EntitlementId.title: EntitlementId
EntitlementId.description: Opaque entitlement identity: "entitlement:" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ListingId.title: ListingId
ListingId.description: Opaque marketplace listing identity: "listing:" followed by a lowercase slug (stable across versions).

UsageStreamId.title: UsageStreamId
UsageStreamId.description: Opaque usage-stream identity: "stream:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar).

NonNegativeDecimal.title: NonNegativeDecimal
NonNegativeDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal amount as a canonical string (digest-safe, no exponent form).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
